content_sections.text: Other conditions: Applications invited only from Indian citizens Technical Assistant desirable: proficiency in data entry and related management work Technical Assistant desirable: good knowledge of MS Office tools and working on computers Desirable: JRF 0601: Work experience in plant taxonomy, medicinal and aromatic plants, forest surveys and conservation Biology JRF 0601: Experience and sound knowledge of field work in mountainous region and plant sample collection JRF 0602: Experience/training in watershed management, field investigation, hydrological modeling (HECRAS, SWAT), Remote sensing & GIS, water resource management JRF 0602: Exposure to Matlab, Python and R-Studio Technical Assistant: Working experience in the Himalayan Region, particularly in high altitude regions

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: First class Master degree in Botany, Computer Science, Bioinformatics or related subjects from a recognized university with NET qualification. Age limit: Maximum 28 years. Pay: @Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month with NET/GATE (as per norms). Qualification required: B.Sc. in Biological Science, Environmental Sciences, Chemistry, Agriculture, Horticulture, Food Technology or related subject/ 3 years diploma in Engineering and Technology in related subjects. Experience required: Desirable: working experience in the Himalayan Region, particularly in high altitude regions. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: @ Rs.20,000 + HRA per month.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely project-based temporary position The engagement is purely temporary in nature Selected candidates are expected to join immediately Institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning reasons

rows.event: Last Date for Online Application (11:59 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will NIHE Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting Interview/Test Short-listed candidates will be informed separately about mode of interview, date and time Institute may raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number called for interview/test if applications are large Minimum qualification/experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original documents of educational qualifications and experience at the interview One set of photocopies of these documents Experience certificate (experience not considered without it)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIHE Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online recruitment portal https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php. Submit the application on or before 11:59 PM on 27th November 2026. Mention in the application all qualifications and experience above the minimum, supported with documents.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the Interview Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification Institute may increase or decrease the number of positions or not fill any post Decision of the Institute on eligibility, selection and interview is final

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF), 1 Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Junior Research Fellow (JRF): maximum 28 years; Technical Assistant: maximum 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: @Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month with NET/GATE (as per norms) for Junior Research Fellow (JRF), @ Rs.20,000 + HRA per month for Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: JRF: First class Master/Post Graduate degree in the specified subjects with NET qualification. Technical Assistant: B.Sc. in Biological Science, Environmental Sciences, Chemistry, Agriculture, Horticulture, Food Technology or related subject, or 3 years diploma in Engineering and Technology in related subjects. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications invited only from Indian citizens. Technical Assistant desirable: proficiency in data entry and related management work. Technical Assistant desirable: good knowledge of MS Office tools and working on computers.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not Indian citizens.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview/Test. Short-listed candidates will be informed separately about mode of interview, date and time. Institute may raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number called for interview/test if applications are large.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely project-based temporary position. The engagement is purely temporary in nature. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately.
